metadata.title: Leuprorelin 11.25 mg Therapy – 12 weeks
metadata.indication: Prostatic carcinoma for which testosterone suppression is indicated.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain explicitly unassessed and never block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source-reconciled draft; independent approval pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current NCCP and product information reconciled for this release; declared discrepancies and independent review remain outstanding.

source_discrepancies: NCCP specifies 84 days; the SmPC uses calendar months. Use the written prescription and reconcile any difference.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by the appropriately qualified Consultant specified in the NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification or non-standard continuation should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Source-reconciled feasibility encoding for NCCP 00492 v3; current source and independent clinical/pharmacy review remain required.

hypersensitivity.label: Hypersensitivity to this medicine or its excipients

qt_risk.label: QT prolongation history/risk or concomitant QT-prolonging medicine

uncontrolled_glucose_or_diabetes.label: Diabetes or glucose control requiring review

bone_health_not_addressed.label: Bone health and fracture risk have not been addressed

prior_permanent_stop.label: Previous permanent stop or contraindication remains in force

suboptimal_response.label: Clinical/PSA response is suboptimal or testosterone suppression is uncertain

flare_protection_not_reviewed.label: Initial testosterone flare and need for anti-androgen protection have not been reviewed

spinal_cord_compression_or_spinal_mets.label: Spinal cord compression or spinal metastases where this would be sole treatment

acute_neurological_or_obstructive_sympto.label: New leg weakness, bladder/bowel dysfunction or urinary obstruction

depression_or_severe_mood_change.label: Depression or severe mood change requiring assessment

formulation_or_route_mismatch.label: Strength, product or administration route does not match the prescription

incorrectly_prepared_dose.label: The prepared dose does not meet product preparation instructions

severe_blistering_or_mucosal_rash.label: Severe blistering, peeling skin or mucosal rash suggesting a serious skin reaction

severe_headache_or_visual_change.label: Severe or recurrent headache with visual change, vomiting or other concerning neurological symptoms

injection_site_abscess.label: Injection-site abscess or concern about depot absorption

endocrine_insensitive_disease.label: Disease established to be insensitive to endocrine therapy (not merely castration-resistant)

action.message: Hypersensitivity is an exclusion. Confirm the reaction and exact formulation.

rules.explanation: Hypersensitivity is an exclusion. Confirm the reaction and exact formulation.

action.message: Assess QT-prolongation and torsades risk, interacting medicines and need for ECG/electrolyte review. This is a benefit-risk review, not an invented automatic QT stop threshold.

rules.explanation: Assess QT-prolongation and torsades risk, interacting medicines and need for ECG/electrolyte review. This is a benefit-risk review, not an invented automatic QT stop threshold.

action.message: Review glucose control and monitoring during androgen deprivation. No universal glucose dose-reduction threshold is supplied by this regimen.

rules.explanation: Review glucose control and monitoring during androgen deprivation. No universal glucose dose-reduction threshold is supplied by this regimen.

action.message: Address fracture risk, bone-health assessment, exercise, calcium and vitamin D according to individual need and local policy. Do not assume every patient needs a bone-metastasis-dose agent.

rules.explanation: Address fracture risk, bone-health assessment, exercise, calcium and vitamin D according to individual need and local policy. Do not assume every patient needs a bone-metastasis-dose agent.

action.message: Review pre-existing cardiovascular disease and modifiable risk factors before and during ADT.

rules.explanation: Review pre-existing cardiovascular disease and modifiable risk factors before and during ADT.

action.message: A previously documented permanent stop remains in force; recovered measurements do not authorise re-exposure.

source.scope_note: Implementation history/confirmation guard derived from source warning; not a new source numeric threshold.

rules.explanation: A previously documented permanent stop remains in force; recovered measurements do not authorise re-exposure.

action.message: Review symptoms, PSA, testosterone suppression, adherence/administration and the overall disease plan. Do not assume isolated PSA change mandates stopping ADT.

rules.explanation: Review symptoms, PSA, testosterone suppression, adherence/administration and the overall disease plan. Do not assume isolated PSA change mandates stopping ADT.

action.message: GnRH agonists can initially raise testosterone. Review flare risk, monitoring and need for a prescribed short anti-androgen course; do not apply a universal bicalutamide duration.

rules.explanation: GnRH agonists can initially raise testosterone. Review flare risk, monitoring and need for a prescribed short anti-androgen course; do not apply a universal bicalutamide duration.

action.message: NCCP excludes leuprorelin as sole treatment with spinal cord compression or spinal metastases.

rules.explanation: NCCP excludes leuprorelin as sole treatment with spinal cord compression or spinal metastases.

action.message: Urgent assessment for cord compression or obstruction. Do not delay emergency management for routine ADT administration; the treating team decides the hormone strategy.

rules.explanation: Urgent assessment for cord compression or obstruction. Do not delay emergency management for routine ADT administration; the treating team decides the hormone strategy.

action.message: Assess and treat mood symptoms promptly; severe depression may occur with hormone suppression.

rules.explanation: Assess and treat mood symptoms promptly; severe depression may occur with hormone suppression.

action.message: Withhold a mismatched product/route. This Prostap 3 DCS 11.25 mg prostate service uses SC or IM; confirm preparation and the prescribed interval.

rules.explanation: Withhold a mismatched product/route. This Prostap 3 DCS 11.25 mg prostate service uses SC or IM; confirm preparation and the prescribed interval.

source.scope_note: Implementation history/confirmation guard derived from source warning; not a new source numeric threshold.

action.message: NCCP specifies 84 days for 11.25 mg. Confirm the exact prescription: calendar months and fixed-day intervals are not interchangeable.

rules.explanation: NCCP specifies 84 days for 11.25 mg. Confirm the exact prescription: calendar months and fixed-day intervals are not interchangeable.

source.scope_note: Implementation history/confirmation guard derived from source warning; not a new source numeric threshold.

action.message: The product SmPC contraindicates this leuprorelin product after orchiectomy; it cannot further lower testosterone after surgical castration. Confirm the history and treatment plan.

rules.explanation: The product SmPC contraindicates this leuprorelin product after orchiectomy; it cannot further lower testosterone after surgical castration. Confirm the history and treatment plan.

action.message: Do not administer an incorrectly prepared, damaged, expired or non-uniform suspension. Prepare immediately before use using the exact product instructions.

rules.explanation: Do not administer an incorrectly prepared, damaged, expired or non-uniform suspension. Prepare immediately before use using the exact product instructions.

action.message: Stop further leuprorelin and obtain urgent assessment for a severe cutaneous reaction such as Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis. The treating specialist decides the alternative hormone strategy.

rules.explanation: Stop further leuprorelin and obtain urgent assessment for a severe cutaneous reaction such as Stevens-Johnson syndrome or toxic epidermal necrolysis. The treating specialist decides the alternative hormone strategy.

action.message: Arrange urgent assessment for pituitary apoplexy, intracranial hypertension or another acute cause. Do not give the next dose before clinical review; a depot already given continues releasing medicine.

rules.explanation: Arrange urgent assessment for pituitary apoplexy, intracranial hypertension or another acute cause. Do not give the next dose before clinical review; a depot already given continues releasing medicine.

action.message: Check testosterone and response because an injection-site abscess can reduce depot absorption.

rules.explanation: Check testosterone and response because an injection-site abscess can reduce depot absorption.

action.message: Product information excludes endocrine-insensitive disease. Castration-resistant disease alone is not synonymous with loss of benefit from continued ADT.

rules.explanation: Product information excludes endocrine-insensitive disease. Castration-resistant disease alone is not synonymous with loss of benefit from continued ADT.

administration.instructions: Prepare and administer immediately using the Prostap 3 DCS instructions; rotate sites.

treatment.duration_text: Individual duration according to the treatment plan
treatment.schedule_summary: Leuprorelin 11.25 mg (Prostap 3 DCS) every 84 days, SC or IM.

regular: FBC, renal and liver profile as clinically indicated
Blood glucose and bone profile as clinically indicated
Symptoms, PSA and testosterone; confirm suppression when response is suboptimal or a depot abscess occurs.

dose_modifications.general: No source count or transaminase thresholds are specified for routine depot dosing.

supportive_care.other: Calcium and vitamin D supplementation according to local policy.
